_meta.what: The nine acquisition entries from notes/ACQUISITION_LIST.md, written in NODE FORM so the node-driven data collection channel can consume them.
_meta.why: Measured 2026-10-03 05:40: 57 data collection jobs in three hours search for public raw data, but they are driven by GRAPH NODES and zero of them hit any of our nine named acquisition entries. The overlap is generic words: concentration 13, area 11, permeability 5, flux 4, clearance 3, conductance 2, GFR 1. The specific quantities (Cread, DEJ separation work, rete ridge geometry, fibril fracture work) get zero hits. The channel works and is pointed elsewhere.
_meta.status: PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW. This CHANGES no other lane's controller or queue. It is consumable material; routing into the channel requires the channel owner's OK.
_meta.key_rule: Each entry carries a quantity, UNIT and what changes if the measurement is made. An entry without a unit cannot be searched for.
_meta.source: notes/ACQUISITION_LIST.md (nine entries, entry 7 rewritten 2026-10-02 after the ratio alone was proved insufficient)
